book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mak wana Leleli

content: Yudiya wali Tohouwa Kamwasa Hi Loya ge Yeisu Nihi Lopaaliga

Lan eluwa ya i mina yaka Nopalegi Hagalena ana sauga, i ola al Pwalawa toto Nige alona Yis Hi Vivikuhiya Hagalena. Inoke topowon bwabwatal avaliyau ge Logugui ana topankite kamwasa hi loya ga nihi ola ge Yeisu nihi lib sume ge nihi lopaaliga.
Hi ba, “Bahi ta giginola hagali ana sauga elana, eba abwe gamagalau nihi lohaveyan.”
Yova Etega Enonu I Holek Yeisu Kokowanaa

Yeisu iyoho Bedani i aanan Saimon tolepelo wana limiya. Inoke yova etega i nem elana patuna ana awa waiwaisana i noahe, gamwanaa, enonu bwalena waiwaisana ge molana bwabwatana, alana nad. Inoke patuna awana i tagayoho ge enonu i holek Yeisu kokowanaa.
Bolo alonau hi aanan enuna ateliya i elolol, inoke hi pebaaba-agil hi ba, “Hauna kaiwena enonu i apapanak-an bwabwage?
Binimala ta palian yaka molana mani silba ali gewi tili handeled ge pwatanaa al ta ahe, ge ta pek togulagula elal.” Inoke hi anagebigebi-an nabiyan.
Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Nuku pialiyoho ya. Hauna kaiwena ge ku anagebigebi-an? Ginol waiwaisana te i ginol eliyau e.
Togulagula alomiyau ya sauga gegewena, ge sauga toto ebo nuwamiu nuku label, bosowaimiu ya nuku label. Yaa nau nige sauga gegewena alomiu i oola.
Bugul toto i gana eliyana ge i nuwatuan ni ginol kaiweu, he iyaka i ginol. Enonu i holek tuwawa, he i ola tuwau iyaka i abubun haba o teliteli kaiwena.
Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, panayawi mamanana elana, hauna labi elana ebo wasa waiwaisana nihi papaatena-an, bugul toto yova ya i ginol nihi liwanan, iya ana abanuwahikan.”
Yudasa I Na Topowon Bwabwatal elal
Inoke Yudasa Isikaliyota, tohago bolo ali toto elulutega eluwa avaliya etegana, i egon i na topowon bwabwatal elal i ba ni label ge Yeisu nihi lib.

Topowon bwabwatal nuwaliya i waisi nabi Yudasa wana baaba kaiwena, ge hi bateli abwe mani nihi pek elana. Inoke Yudasa i telipuna Yeisu wana nawanawa i gagayawa-an, kamwasa i loya ge Yeisu ni teli nimaliyaa ge nihi lib.
Yeisu alonau wana Tohago Nopalegi Hagalena Hi Ginol

Pwalawa toto Nige alona Yis Hi Vivikuhiya Hagalena ana lan telipuna elana, Yudiya wali pagan te sipi natuna etega nihi lol Nopalegi Hagalena kaiwena. Inoke tohago Yeisu hi neli hi ba, “Hauna labena elana nuwam naha noek ge aanan naha lovivina-an kaiwem, inoke ta anan ni ola Nopalegi Hagalena ana logugui?”
Inoke wana tohago eluwa i patunal i baek elal i ba, “Nuku nok nuku na nuku tuk Yelusalema, tau etega wewel ana ulubwal i kalivai abwe ni pwawamiu. Nuku noulil,
nuku na limi toto elana ni ulutuka, inoke nuku baek tonlimi elana nuku ba, ‘Topankite i ba: Hauna lum u talamwan ge alowau no tohago Nopalegi Hagalena enona naha ginola ge naha an?’
Inoke iya abwe limi gamwana bwabwatana toto natiya ni pankitemiu, iyaka hi abubun haba. Inoke nuku na aanan nuku lovivina-an kaiwela.”
Inoke tohago hi nok hi na Yelusalema, ge bugul gegewena hi pwawa i ola to Yeisu wana baaba elal. Inoke Nopalegi Hagalena enona hi lovivina-an.
Sauga bulin i gan, yaka Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago ali toto elulutega eluwa hi na hi vin.
Sauga hi misiyo ge hi aanan teibol elana, inoke i baek tohago elal i ba, “Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, gamwamiwa etega nasi abwe ni wasaagau, he iya iyahe te avala ta aanan e.”
Tohago ateliya i lomwan nabi, inoke maisena ge maisena i nelnel Yeisu elana i ba, “Nau nige i oola, age?”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Ami toto elulutega eluwa gamwamiwa, etega nasi abwe ni wasaagau, iya ge nau nimama i lau mwaha maisena gamwanaa.

Gamagal Natuna nau na aliga ni ola Buki Bwabwalena wana baaba, yaa gamagal toto ni wasaagau nuwau i nakan, kaiwena bwaliga ana lahi ni bwaya. Binimala valila tau o bahi hinana ni aab, inoke lahi bwabwatana nige ni pwapwawa.”
Sauga hi aanan, Yeisu beleid i ahe, i ba mulolu Yehoba elana yaka i pigebagebal-an i pek wana tohago elal ge i ba, “Ku ahe ku an. Toto ya iya tuwau.”
Inoke oine ana kom i ahe, i ba mulolu Yehoba elana, i pek elal ge gegewel hi im.
Sauga i pek elal i ba, “Toto ya saliyau, iya bateli vavaluna i patunahot. Saliyau ni lau gamagalau nihi gewi kaiweliya.
Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, oine nige al na iim, ana siga Yehoba wana abalogugui elana abwe oine vavaluna na im.”
Yaka wona etega hi wonaan ge hi tagil hi na Oya Olibe.
Pita I Ba Tage Nige Yeisu Ni Aalahan
Yeisu i baek wana tohago elal i ba, “Nasi abwe gegewemiu nuku lou luwagau, kaiwena Buki Bwabwalena i ba, ‘Sipi ali tomatahikan na lol inoke sipi nihi tatawaliwali tomaha ge tomaha nihi nonoek.’
Yaa no lut al enaa, na houwa na na Galili, yaka mulaa abwe nuku nem.”
Inoke Pita Yeisu anana i lahe i ba, “Bwagana ebo alowau gegewel nihi lou, yaa nau nige na lolou luwagiwa.”
Yeisu i baek Pita elana i ba, “Ya ba tunahot eliyam, bulin ebe kamkam melutauina nigeya ga ni kakahin palabui, inoke nu alahagau paeton.”
Yaa Pita i ba balbalgig i ba, “Nige na aalahagiwa, bwagana ebo alou owa ta yaomal.” Yaka gegewel hi baaba hi ola al Pita wana baaba.
Yeisu I Na I Awanun Getesemani
Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago hi nok hi na labi toto alana Getesemani, inoke i baek elal i ba, “Ku minaa te, na na ga na awanun.”
Pita, Yemesa ge Diyon i ahel alonau hi nok, inoke sauga o atena i lomwan nabi.
Yaka i baek elal i ba, “Ateu i lomwan nabi, lomwan o kelaubwa ni paaligau. Ku miminaa te ge nuku silawa.”
I peliluwagil nige ana bwaga i gagan, inoke i talpo bilibiliya ge i awanun Tamana elana ebo bosowaina, inoke bahi ni tutuk lomwan ana sauga elana.
I awanun i ba, “Nam! Nam! Bugul gegewena i bosowaim. He lomwan ana kom ya u ahek yoho eliyau. Yaa bahi nau no nuwatu, owa ya wam nuwatu.”
Inoke i sikal tohago eton elal ge i kitel hi kenu mati. I baek Pita elana i ba, “Saimon, age owa iyahe u kenukenu? Ga i ola ge nige bosowaim auwa maisena ya nu silawa?
Nuku silawa ge nuku awanun, inoke bahi lawakik kaiwena ge nuku sosogu. Yayaluwamiu nuwana waisi ni ginol, yaa tuwamiu i pweyata.”
I nok palabuina al i na i awanun ola to wana awanun houhouwena.
Sauga i sikal, i kitel al hi kenukenu, kaiwena mataliya i aliga nabi. He nige hi aatena Yeisu anana ga nihi lahe ola.

Yaka i na i awanun al. Sauga i sikal paetonina tohago elal, i ba, “Age komiu iyahe ya ku kenukenu? Besemiu kenu! Ku kite, sauga iyaka i vin ge Gamagal Natuna nihi talamwan gamagalau nanakil nimaliyaa.
Ku lut ta noewa elal. Tau toto i tatalamwagau sauga ya iyaka i vin!”
Yeisu Hi Lib

Sauga Yeisu iyoho ya i baaba, inoke Yudasa i vin, iya Yeisu wana tohago bolo elulutega eluwa avaliya etega. Alonau ge boda bwabwatana, bolo topowon bwabwatal, Logugui ana topankite ge Yudiya wali tohouwa hi patunal. He elohaveyan kilepana ge ebwakil toguina hi noahe.
Yeisu ana towasa etotohi etega iyaka i baunanik haba boda elal i ba, “Tau toto na nalo heiya te nuku lib ge nuku yowan, inoke nuku en egonan ge nuku matahikan.”
Sauga Yudasa i vin, i nopasapu i na Yeisu elana i ba, “Topankite,” inoke i nalo.
Yaka gamagalau hi na Yeisu hi lib ge hi yowan.
Bolo hi taltalmilila Yeisu labenaa, avaliya etega wana elohaveyan kilepana i momol tagilanem abanaa, inoke topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana totuwalali etega tanana i goyoho.
Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Age nau toawatautau ge topihigelgel inoke haveyan kilepana ge ebwakil toguina ku noahe ge ku nem tage nuku libau?
Lan gegewena alowau ya komiu Limi Bwabwalena elana ya panpankiti, inoke nige ku lilibau. Yaa ni masal ni ola te, inoke Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba ni tabwa tunahot.”
Inoke sauga o wana tohago gegewel hi lou luwai.
Heval etegana, kaliko maisena ya te i minaa tuwanaa, iyoho Yeisu i noulil. Ana kaliko hi kukuhikan tage hi lilib,
yaa kaliko i lou luwan nimaliyaa, ge i lou bobokana ya.
Yudiya wali Tologugui Yeisu Hi Payatala
Yeisu hi ahe hi pwatanik topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana limiya, yaka topowon bwabwatal gegewel, avaliyau Yudiya wali tohouwa ge Logugui ana topankite hi nogogowa to.
Pita Yeisu i noulil ana bwaga i gan ana siga hi na hi ulutuk topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana bakubakuwa. Inoke alonau totuwalali hi misiyowa to, ge iya i amwaligu ginaha elana.
Topowon bwabwatal avaliyau ge Yudiya wali tologugui gegewel, Yeisu ana woliwoli hi loyaan ge bosowaina nihi ba ni aliga. Yaa nige etegana hi pwapwawa.
Gamagalau hi gewi wali ba kakakawi hi baunan Yeisu kaiwena, yaa wali baaba nige i oolaolaek.
Inoke gamagalau enuna hi nem ge Yeisu hi wole kakawe hi ba,
“Ama tau ya wana baaba ha hago i ba, ‘Limi Bwabwalena ya gamagalau nimaliya elana hi tal na pasamwalekaleka, inoke lan eton gamwanaa etegana na tal al, toto nige ni oola gamagalau wali taltal.’”
Yaa bwagana heliya hi ba ola o, wali baaba nige i oolaolaek al.
Topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa i lut ge i talmilil tonogogo gegewel mataliyaa, yaka i nel Yeisu elana i ba, “Ga i ola ge nige analiya u lalahe? Baaba toto hi baunan kaiwem, ana sapu ga i ola?”
Yaa Yeisu i mikekei nige anana etega i lalahe. Inoke topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa i nel al elana i ba, “Owa Mesaiya, Yehoba Towasawasa Natuna, o ebo nigeya?”
Yeisu anana i lahe i ba, “Nau heiya te. He abwe nau Gamagal Natuna nuku kiteyau na misiyowa Yehoba Togasisi labena awonaa, ge na neem yaluyalu pwatanaa.”
Yaka topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa i huga, inoke totona ana kaliko i kukuleli ge i ba, “He besena to. Nige al ta loloya tage gamagalau nihi nem ge nihi baaba tau ya kaiwena.
Iyaka ku hago i ba likalika. Ga ku nuwatu ola?” Inoke gegewel hi talam hi ba, “I bosowaina hot ni aliga.”

Inoke gamagalau enuna Yeisu hi kuluve, ge kaliko hi ahe matana hi am kaus, yaka nimaliya elana hi nibinibihan ge hi ba, “Ebo owa palopita, inoke u baem eliyama, henala ge i nibihiwa?” Inoke topowon bwabwatal wali pulisiman Yeisu hi ahe ge hi nibinibihan.
Pita Yeisu I Alahan
Pita iyoho paiya bakubakuwa, inoke topowon bwabwatal wali tohouwa wana totuwalali galokau avaliya etega i nem to.
Sauga i kite i amwaamwaligu, inoke i gayawaan bubun ge i ba, “He owa al ge Yeisu gagama Nasaleta alona etega.”
Yaa Pita i alaha i ba, “Nige ya aatena hauna gun u babaunan ei.” Inoke i na i tagil abauluulutuk elana. Yaka kamkam melutauina etega i kahin.
Galok totuwalali Pita i kite al, inoke i baek gamagalau bolo hi taltalmilil o elal i ba, “Tau ya iya avaliya etega.”
Yaka Pita i alaha palabuina. Sauga nige i yayapu, gamagalau bolo hi taltalmilil labenaa hi baek elana hi ba, “Tunahot owa Yeisu wana boda avaliya etega, kaiwena owa gagama Galili.”
Inoke Pita i papasila i ba, “Ya baaba tunahot, tau toto bana ku babaa ei, nige ya aatena. Binimala nige na babaa tunahot, Yehoba ni laheyau.”

Sauga o kamkam melutauina i kahin palabuina, inoke Pita Yeisu wana baaba i nuwatuan toto i ba, “Kamkam melutauina nige ga ni kakahin palabui, inoke nu alahagau paeton.” Yaka Pita atena i lomwan nabi ge i kahin.
